info.title: RIMAPI
info.description: Canonical HTTP contract for the pinned RIMAPI fork. Legacy responses use snake_case and omit null properties. Construction v2 uses strict generated contracts. Documentation coverage is independent of AI action authorization. Camera control is HTTP; frame delivery uses the configured UDP destination. Third-party extension routes are outside this built-in contract.

get.description: Long-lived SSE connection. Initial connected and gameState events, heartbeat events, and game-hook/extension events. gameUpdate is a registered name but has no periodic publisher in this build. Event data uses native property names (including PascalCase in gameState), not the HTTP snake_case resolver. Event names and payloads are extensible. Camera frames are delivered over UDP, not SSE.

get.summary: Strategic resource overview of the explored map
get.description: Counts and native yields for plants, wildlife, ore, loose supplies, fertility and fishing, with nearby counts and inspection coordinates. Terrain is cached for at most 2500 game ticks and invalidated by terrain/fog changes; refresh_terrain forces a rebuild. Distances are straight-line, not safety or reachability. Food crop fertility counts are potential land, not a placement guarantee.

get.summary: Observe queued construction and native worker/material checks
get.description: Read-only paginated blueprint/frame observations. Native CanConstruct checks are unforced, with current work priorities. Accessible supplies can be reserved and reached by at least one eligible worker; stocks are shared across sites, not allocated, and no job or guaranteed safe delivery is implied. Current job targets indicate attention, not proof of progress.

post.description: Immediately allow all explored forbidden items on this map except insect jelly. Uses the native Allow designator. No item IDs or hauling required. Jelly is skipped, not re-forbidden. Other items near threats are NOT excluded. Returns changed, excluded-jelly and remaining eligible counts.
Count explored forbidden items eligible for Unforbid All and exempt insect jelly. Does not change flags; changed_count is zero.
